notes: Three stakeholder conflicts, one of them regulatory. Tests conflict detection and attribution.
input:
Notes from onboarding kickoff (Mon)
Rahul (Product): Account opening must be fully digital — no branch visit, done in under 5 minutes.
Meera (Compliance): Every new customer must complete video KYC with a live agent, which usually takes 10-15 minutes including the queue.
Rahul: We want to launch for anyone 16 and older.
Meera: Accounts are only for adults, 18+.
Tech: We'll store ID document images for 30 days then delete them.
Meera: Regulations need us to keep KYC records for 5 years.

requirements: video KYC with a live agent
questionsAbout: how long ID images and KYC records are kept
whether the 5-minute target includes KYC queue time
conflicts: account opening under 5 minutes vs video KYC taking 10-15 minutes
delete ID images after 30 days vs keep KYC records for 5 years
mustNotInvent: a named regulator stated as explicit
